196221.overview:
Saddle up for a wild ride with the Devil Riders! Flames, motorcycles, and hardcore stunts await in this metal-fueled table.

Devil Riders is a solid-state pinball machine manufactured by Zaccaria in April, 1984 featuring a daredevil/stunt motorcycle theme. The machine features a 3D-moulded backbox with a mechanical motorcycle that performs a loop-the-loop whenever the ball enters the upper playfield. Approximately 2,216 units were produced, making it one of the more accessible Zaccaria titles for modern collectors.

The table was recreated by Magic Pixel and released as DLC for Zaccaria Pinball on Steam on 16 June, 2016. It can be quite a frustrating table to play due to the frequency with which the ball goes straight down the middle of the flippers, or down the side lanes, and the table has a lot of negative reviews on Steam.

208978.overview: DOOM is one of the three pinball tables in the Bethesda Pinball mini table pack, released in 2016 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the sci-fi horror first-person shooter video game series of the same name, created by id Software, it primarily takes inspiration from the 2016 reboot of DOOM while incorporating elements from the three major titles released before it (Doom, Doom II and Doom 3). The table follows the Doom Slayer's mission to brutally eradicate demonic forces throughout Mars, Hell and beyond with an array of deadly weapons to protect humanity.

208987.overview: Doctor Strange is one of the Marvel pinball tables originally released in 2013 as a standalone in Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, then ported to Pinball FX3 in 2017 as part of the Marvel Legends DLC pack. The table is based on the Doctor Strange comic series, featuring the adventures of Stephen Strange and his fights against magical threats taking over the world.

448322.overview: Star Wars: Darth Vader is a pinball table based on the iconic Sith Lord Darth Vader as one of a multitude of Star Wars Zen Pinball tables available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. This table is one of the three tables in the Balance of the Force pack and covers the history of the galaxy's most feared and infamous Sith Lord, from the completion of his life support armor to his eventual redemption by his son, Luke Skywalker.

460237.overview: Disco Dancing is a rare solid-state game released in 1979 by the Brazilian manufacturer LTD do Brasil. Produced during the height of the disco era, it captures the nightlife culture of the late 1970s through its vibrant artwork, loosely reminiscent of the 1977 John Travolta movie, Saturday Night Fever.

460238.overview: Drakor, released by Taito do Brasil in late 1979 or early 1980, is a notable example of the Brazilian "clone" era of pinball. During this period, Taito’s Brazilian subsidiary frequently adapted popular American designs for the local market, often introducing their own unique artwork and custom Drakor is a Brazilian adaptation of Williams' iconic 1979 machine, Gorgar. The artwork, created by Constantino Mitchell and Jeanine Mitchell, features a distinct dark fantasy/demon theme that differs from the original Williams aesthetic.

464015.overview:
Players unite against the Lords of Hell!

Digital table for Visual Pinball X based on the characters of Blizzard Entertainment's 2012 game, Diablo III.

468556.overview:
Deadpool is one of a multitude of Marvel pinball tables released in 2014, available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Originally released as a standalone table, it was released as part of the Heavy Hitters pack-

Alright, enough of that boring, boilerplate article intro stuff! When you write an article about the Merc with the Mouth, YOU KNOW WHAT TO EXPECT, RIGHT? So you say THIS article is about a pinball table celebrating all things me, right? Well, let me tell you, this is basically the most awesome pinball table YOU'LL ever play - because it has ME in it, and you'll get a glimpse of all the mayhem that I've been through in missions and modes mostly based on what my creators Fabian and Rob put me through. You think it's all superhero-ey stuff, like all the other Marvel tables you've played? Well, you might wanna think again... those developers have a mind of their own...

Oh, and by the way, this isn't the only pinball table about me. Those folks at Stern Pinball decided to make a REAL one back in 2018, and you know you've made it when you have a physical pinball machine named after you.

468559.overview:
A table based on the first installment of the animated film trilogy adaptation of Cressida Cowell's book series. Young Viking teenager Hiccup, after trapping the rare and dangerous Night Fury dragon, discovers the possibility of taming dragons while his people are being attacked by them.

Released as part of the Dreamworks Pinball pack for Zen Pinball Party for Apple Arcade on 3 September 2021, and subsequently released as DLC for Pinball FX on 15 December 2022.

As DreamWorks is currently owned by Universal Pictures, this table pack was produced as a continuation of Zen Studios' partnership with the firm following the Universal Pictures Classics mini-table pack.

469557.overview:
Hail to the king, baby! Duke Nukem is here to shoot jackpots and chew bubblegum, and he’s all out of gum. Enjoy the biggest, grooviest, most BADASS pinball table ever made packed with guns and babes. Push start and play with balls of steel!

•        Take down the alien scum to get the first access card 
•        Start the mini-game and shoot your shot for big points
•        Pull no punches! Free Duke with your pinball skills
•        Bounce the ball on the bumpers and Shake it Baby! Shoot the flashing lanes for millions
•        They messed with the best… Make the Overlord and the Cycloid Emperor eat lead!

469560.overview:
Step into the realm of horror with Dead by Daylight™ Pinball. Become the hunter or even the hunted in a thrilling fusion of classic pinball and the excitement of one of the most popular horror games ever created.

- Test your skills as The Trapper, outwitting Survivors who attempt to escape your cleaver
- Aim well and find the Survivors before they fix the Generators
- Chase them down before they escape to start the Hook Multiball for Double Jackpots
- Or play with 4 different Survivors, all with unique abilities that affect gameplay
- Hit the Skill Checks in a special video mode to raise your points
- Use your skills during an exciting chase to avoid being sacrificed to The Entity

Listen to your heartbeat getting loud as you pray that The Trapper finds someone else.

470094.overview: An original digital table for Visual Pinball 9 based on Nintendo's classic 1984 NES light gun shooter game.

470302.overview:
Join The Crescendolls on their galaxy tour in DAFT PUNK’s Interstella 5555! You will help them put on the best shows by learning Melodies and releasing hit Records. Upgrade your ball from “Homework” to “Human After All”, and rock out to your favorite DAFT PUNK samples, loops, and songs throughout the game.

A homebrew digital table released for Visual Pinball X.

470311.overview: Homebrew table for Visual Pinball 9 based on Nintendo's classic arcade game from 1981.

470422.overview:
The outlaw ride continues! Heavy metal vibes and fiery ramps bring the biker spirit into the modern age.

Devil Riders 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1984 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470663.overview:
Devil's Advocate is a fictional pinball machine from the animated series "The Simpsons". It has been seen in Captain Blip's Zapateria at Springfield Mall, and at the Kwik-E-Mart. Homer had a game in his garage after he turned it into a bar to spite Moe.

The pinball table has appeared in four different episodes of the show, though its most memorable appearance comes in "Insane Clown Poppy" (Season 12, Episode 3). Homer Simpson asks "Marge, may I play Devil's Advocate for a moment?" Marge replies "Sure, go ahead," after which it is revealed that Homer is actually asking to play a literal Devil's Advocate pinball machine at the arcade.

A homebrew attempt to recreate this table was released by Masalaja for Visual Pinball 9 in October 2018.

470849.overview: Unlicensed homebrew table for Visual Pinball X based on the 1990 MS-DOS game "DuckTales: The Quest For Gold".

470851.overview:
Duran Duran are an English pop rock band formed in Birmingham in 1978. Emerging as one of the most successful bands of the New Romantic scene in the early 1980s, they were innovators of the music video and a leading band in the MTV-driven Second British Invasion of the US. By 1984, the band had achieved levels of fame similar to Beatlemania.

This table is a homebrew mod of Gottlieb's "Count-Down" for Visual Pinball X.

471035.overview: A homebrew table released for Visual Pinball X in 2025 based on Green Day's classic 1994 album Dookie.

472435.overview: An eye-catching graphics and music mod of Bally's 1992 Doctor Who table for Visual Pinball X.

472469.overview:
Dragon's Lair is a video game franchise created by Rick Dyer. The series is notable for its film-quality animation by ex-Disney animator Don Bluth.  Most of the games consist of an interactive film where the player controls Dirk the Daring, in a quest to save Princess Daphne. The game presents predetermined animated scenes, and the player must select a direction on the joystick or press the action button in order to clear each Quick time Event (QtE), with different full motion video segments showing the outcome.

This original pinball table for Visual Pinball X is the first pinball game to feature QtEs. To access the quest, players must hit the gate in the middle of the playfield. The table then displays a video and players must select to move left (left flipper), right (right flipper), or use sword (launch ball / plunger). After successfully completing six quests, players may access the Super Quest, which features two scenes.

474086.overview:
Dead Hunters is a widely acclaimed, original table created by Blindmankind in 2007 for Future Pinball. It is highly regarded in the virtual pinball community as a "must-have" original table due to its atmospheric horror/hunter theme, innovative layout, and specialized gameplay mechanics.

Unlike traditional static targets, this table features dynamic targets that actively move toward the player down the playfield, requiring precise timing and fast flipper reactions to repel them. The defining mechanic of Dead Hunters is its built-in power-up system. Players must utilize these acquired abilities to manage the table's high difficulty curve and maintain gameplay balance. 

To acquire a power-up, players must complete a skill-shot, and then choose the power-up by pressing the SPECIAL BUTTON 1 key, selecting the power-up with the left and right flippers, and by pressing the the SPECIAL BUTTON 1 key again to activate the chosen power-up.

A tweaked version with improved physics, lighting and mechanical sounds was released by SLAMT1LT in 2013 as Dead Hunters: ULTRA Edition.

477740.overview: Based on the Bruce Willis Christmas movie (yes, it is a Christmas movie), Die Hard is a popular original table for Future Pinball by Rom.

479864.overview: Based on Taito's shoot 'em up video game franchise, Darius is an original pinball table first released by Dave Sanders (aka Eala Dubh Sidhe) for an early version of Visual Pinball, and later ported to Future Pinball in 2014 by Ghost Machine. The table has since been ported to Visual Pinball 9 by Furio.

480188.overview:
A tribute to the 2011 first-person shooter game Duke Nukem Forever, this pinball game was released by Jipar for Future Pinball in February 2012.

MAIN RULES:

1. Upper level (left): Clear NUKEM-targets 4 times to light an EXTRABALL, 5 for SPECIAL, during all the game with all the balls.

2. Follow purple way to increase bonus-multiplier and to enable the SAVER.

3. Shoot right captive green ball (1) to open ramp (2) and  to increase timer (10-20-30-40 sec) for flippers on the  level FOREVER. Then shoot all the targets (3) to light an EXTRABALL (2  times for SPECIAL) and to open the JACKPOT gate 60  sec (4) for 1 MILLION. You get also a FREEBALL (+1). 

4. Left captive green ball: 5 hits with the same ball lights an EXTRABALL and gives a FREEBALL (+1).

5. Hit centre green ball to enable JACKPOT-TARGETS mode : 8 targets (40 sec) to get a little JACKPOT (500.000) and a FREEBALL (+1).

6. Lock 3 balls in big tube to enable MULTIBALL mode (+3 targets + 1 ball in the hole) : 4 balls in play.

7. Follow TARGETS to enable DUKE-targets (30 sec) and shoot all of them to get a FREEBALL (+1) and light an EXTRABALL (red ramp); 2 times for SPECIAL. 

8. Take the XB ramp (red) 4 times to light an EXTRABALL, 5 for SPECIAL, and also to collect BONUS, any EXTRABALL or SPECIAL when lit.

9. Shoot the 3 right & left power-targets 2 times each, to light BONUS-gates (50.000 or 20.000)

480274.overview: An original table first released for Visual Pinball 8 in 2008, featuring plenty of fun audio call-outs from the long-running Looney Tunes character.

480305.overview:
Dexter's Laboratory is an American animated science fiction television series created by Genndy Tartakovsky for Cartoon Network. The series follows Dexter, an enthusiastic boy-genius with a science laboratory in his bedroom, which he keeps secret from his unsuspecting parents. Dexter is at constant odds with his older and more extraverted sister Dee Dee, who regularly accesses the laboratory and inadvertently foils his experiments.

This pinball game was released for Visual Pinball 9 in 2017, and is a mod of Mephisto (Cirsa, 1987).

480401.overview:
"It's time to kick ass and chew bubblegum... and I'm all out of gum."

You are Duke Nukem, a muscular, wisecracking action hero who battles against alien invaders. mutant creatures, and evil forces threatening earth. Use your pinball skills to save the world.

The first-person shooter game Duke Nukem 3D was released for MS-DOS in 1996 as the third game in the Duke Nukem series, though the previous two games had been platformers. Duke Nukem 3D features the adventures of the titular Duke Nukem, voiced by Jon St. John, who fights against an alien invasion on Earth. 

Along with Wolfenstein 3D, Doom and Quake, Duke Nukem 3D is considered to be responsible for popularizing first-person shooters, and was released to major critical acclaim. Reviewers praised the interactivity of the environments, gameplay, level design, and unique risqué humor, a mix of pop-culture satire and lampooning of over-the-top Hollywood action heroes. 

However, it also incited controversy due to its violence, erotic elements, and portrayal of women. Since its release, Duke Nukem 3D has been cited as one of the greatest video games ever made, and has left a lasting legacy.

That legacy has extended to pinball, with the game being the theme of an excellent table in the 1997 pinball computer game, Balls of Steel. Furthermore, graphics of a pinball game named Balls of Steel appear in Duke Nukem 3D itself, in the first level, "Hollywood Holocaust", when Duke encounters the table.

The Duke Nukem 3D table released by Ivan TBA for Visual Pinball X in March 2020 features very similar playfield artwork to the table released as part of the Balls of Steel game, but with a more simple playfield layout, as it is a graphical and audio mod of an early solid-state table from 1980, Bally's Skateball.
